question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A formal agreement between two or more nations or peoples
solution:
The correct answer is **"****Pact."****
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Pact" means a formal agreement between two or more people, groups or countries. (दो या दो से अधिक व्‍यक्तियों, समूहों या देशों के बीच औपचारिक समझौता)

 
 
• Example: *The United States and Canada have signed a free-trade **pact**__.*
 
 
 
• 
 
The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is "Pact."

 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Concord: **peace and agreement. (शांति और सामंजस्‍य; मेल व सहमति)
 
• **Bond: **something that joins two or more people or groups of people together, such as a feeling of friendship. (दो व्‍यक्तियों या जनसमूहों को बाँधने या जोड़ने वाली शक्ति, भावना आदि (जैसे मैत्री या बंधुत्‍व); बंधन, संबंध)
 
• **Charter: **a written statement of the rights, beliefs and purposes of an organization or a particular group of people. (किसी संगठन या व्‍यक्ति-समुदाय के अधिकारों, विश्‍वासों और उद्देश्‍यों का लिखित दस्‍तावेज़; अधिकारपत्र)
